channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ministro André Mendonça recebe Colar de Honra ao Mérito em sessão solene na Alesp com presença de Tarcísio e Nunes
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça received the Collar of Honor from the São Paulo Legislative Assembly in a solemn session attended by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Mayor Ricardo Nunes. The honor recognizes his career as Attorney General, Justice Minister, and STF member since 2021. The ceremony featured religious presentations and included authorities from the three branches of government.

item.title: Flávio diz por que foi escolha de Bolsonaro: Não podia tirar Tarcísio de SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said he was chosen by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, as the pre-candidate for president because there was no other viable substitute besides Tarcísio de Freitas to run for governor of São Paulo.

item.title: Tarcísio escolhe duas novas secretárias para o primeiro escalão em São Paulo
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas appointed two new women to his cabinet: Claudia Carletto as Secretary of Sports and Ana Biselli Aidar as Secretary of Tourism and Travel. Both began transition and planning agendas with their technical teams on Tuesday. The appointments reinforce the administration’s commitment to increasing female leadership in state public administration, raising the number of women leading secretariats in the top tier to eight.

item.title: “Não é inteligente”, diz Flávio sobre postura de Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro's stance, calling it unintelligent. He revealed he has been working behind the scenes to moderate Eduardo's statements, as the latter, living in the U.S., has caused tensions with fellow bolsonarista allies.

item.title: Zema descarta ser vice de Flávio: “Não recebi convite, nem tenho interesse”
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pre-candidate for Novo, stated he did not receive an invitation to be Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) running mate and has no interest in the role. He affirmed he will maintain his pre-candidacy 'until the end' and respects other right-wing pre-candidates.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo defende Neymar após críticas sobre árbitro
item.description: Aldo Rebelo defended footballer Neymar after criticism for remarks about referee Sávio Pereira Sampaio, stating that personal opinions do not justify persecution or hate campaigns. He compared the situation to other Brazilian football icons like Romário and Ronaldo, whose views he did not always share but still admired for elevating Brazil’s global reputation. Rebelo stressed that Neymar’s on-field performance must be respected regardless of his off-field comments.

item.title: Tarcísio critica PT por querer compartilhar paternidade de obras em SP
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) criticized the PT for attempting to share credit for projects like the 17-Ouro Metro Line and the Northern Rodoanel, stating these works were delayed for decades and only completed under his administration. He accused the opposition of using TV propaganda to claim ownership of state achievements, following Fernando Haddad’s (PT) first electoral insert highlighting federal funds for São Paulo infrastructure.

item.title: Câmara quer escolher novo ministro do TCU na 4ª feira
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies began preparing for a secret vote to appoint a new minister to the TCU, with a decision expected on April 8. The vacancy, resulting from the retirement of Aroldo Cedraz, has at least three candidates in contention, including government-backed Odair Cunha (PT-MG), supported by Chamber President Hugo Motta. The position is life-tenured, with salary equivalent to an STJ minister, and holds strategic importance in overseeing public accounts.

item.title: A primeira pesquisa Datafolha sobre eleição para presidente após entrada de Caiado na disputa
item.description: The first Datafolha poll on the 2026 Brazilian presidential election following Ronaldo Caiado’s entry into the race will be conducted from April 7 to 9, with results expected to be released on April 11. Commissioned by Folha de S.Paulo, the survey will interview 2,004 voters in person and cover topics including Supreme Court justices, household debt, and Neymar’s potential call-up for the World Cup. The previous Datafolha poll (March 7) showed Lula at 46% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 43% in a technical tie for the runoff.

item.title: Tarcísio rebate vídeo de Haddad que destaca investimentos federais em obras paulistas: 'grande bobagem'
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas dismissed Fernando Haddad's videos highlighting federal investments in São Paulo's infrastructure as 'great nonsense,' accusing the PT of trying to claim credit for projects like the northern Rodoanel stretch and metro expansions. He argued the public wants delivery, not political maneuvering, and that federal involvement merely financed works already underway or stalled. Haddad countered that the Lula government enabled these projects through direct transfers, BNDES financing, and São Paulo's debt renegotiation.

item.title: O filme citado por Michelle Bolsonaro em meio a farpas entre Nikolas e Eduardo
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro reposted a video by Nikolas Ferreira about the film 'The Passion of the Christ' (2004), following Eduardo Bolsonaro's criticism of the deputy for sharing content from a right-wing page that did not endorse Flávio Bolsonaro. The exchange between Eduardo and Nikolas unfolded on X, with Eduardo accusing the deputy of opportunism and Nikolas responding with irony. Michelle's post does not appear directly tied to the conflict but occurred amid ongoing family and political tensions.

item.title: Eduardo usa atrito com Nikolas como isca para pedir votos fora do país
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro used his feud with Nikolas Ferreira as bait to solicit votes from Brazilians abroad in the 2026 elections, noting that 5 million Brazilians live overseas and could influence the outcome. He reminded viewers that Lula defeated Bolsonaro in 2022 by about 1 million votes and urged sharing the video to discuss what 'really matters'. Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s presidential pre-candidate, intervened to call for unity on the right, lamenting internal conflict.

item.title: Lula aciona o Papai Noel fora de época e lança ‘pacote de bondades’ de olho na eleição
item.description: President Lula has launched an electoral 'package of goodies,' including subsidies for cooking gas and imported/domestic diesel, tax exemptions for aviation kerosene, and a bill to reduce the workweek from 6X1 to 5X2 (40 hours), amid declining approval and rising disapproval. While partly justified by the Iran war’s impact on fuel prices and inflation, the move is widely seen as an electoral ploy to win over low-income voters, the middle class, and producers. However, it faces backlash over fiscal irresponsibility, resistance from Congress and productive sectors, and a strong social media counterattack from the opposition, highlighting governmental disarray and lack of strategy six months before the election.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira e Eduardo Bolsonaro discutem, e Flávio pede união
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro called for unity among allies, urging them to overcome internal conflicts for the sake of a larger project. The appeal came after a public dispute between former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro and federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira on social media. The video was posted as Flávio positions himself as a pre-candidate for the presidency in 2026.

item.title: Flávio diz que tenta ‘segurar onda’ de Eduardo após críticas a aliados: ‘Não é inteligente’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro said he is working to curb his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro's controversial statements to prevent internal conflicts within the bolsonarist movement, stressing the need for unity to make his 2026 presidential candidacy viable. He also praised deputy Nikolas Ferreira as a strategic ally, acknowledging the tension between Eduardo and Nikolas over campaign strategies but affirming both are key right-wing leaders.

item.title: Governo anuncia medidas contra aumento dos combustíveis devido à guerra no Oriente Médio
item.description: The government announced measures to counter rising fuel prices caused by the Middle East war, including diesel subsidies, biodiesel tax exemptions, liquefied gas import subsidies, credit lines for the aviation sector, and removal of taxes on aviation kerosene. It will also toughen penalties for abusive price hikes. The aim is to mitigate inflationary pressure ahead of the October elections, in a context of a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in recent polls.

item.title: Petrobras demite diretor de Comercialização e aponta presidente interino do Conselho de Administração
item.description: Petrobras dismissed its Commercialization Director, Claudio Schlosser, following a liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) auction that resulted in prices above internal benchmarks, sparking internal unrest and being labeled by CEO Magda Chambriard as an act of insubordination, particularly amid government efforts to curb fuel price increases. He has been replaced by Angélica Laureano, former Director of Energy Transition, while William França will temporarily assume her role. The Commercialization Directorate is a key revenue generator, overseeing fuel sales, pricing, logistics, and both domestic and international distribution of products like gasoline, diesel, LPG, jet fuel, and biofuels.

item.title: O ator escolhido para interpretar Nelson Rodrigues no teatro
item.description: Actor Bruce Gomlevsky has been cast to portray Nelson Rodrigues in the play "Nelson Rodrigues – O passado sempre tem razão", premiering May 1st at the Banco do Brasil Cultural Center in Rio de Janeiro. The production explores themes such as football, adultery, and theater, highlighting the writer’s controversial stance, including his initial support for the Military Dictatorship and opposition to the 'intellectual left'. Gomlevsky previously played Raul Seixas in 2025 and Renato Russo in 2022.

item.title: Lindbergh pede prisão preventiva de Eduardo Bolsonaro após declarações sobre eleições
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT) requested the preventive arrest of Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) after the latter stated he would report alleged irregularities by Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) to the U.S. government under Donald Trump. Lindbergh characterized the remarks as an attempt to delegitimize Brazil's electoral system and interfere with national sovereignty. The request followed Eduardo Bolsonaro's comments, made while he was not holding elected office.

item.title: Novo subsídio ao diesel nacional custará R$ 3 bi por mês
item.description: The federal government approved a subsidy of R$ 0.80 per liter for domestically produced diesel, adding to an existing benefit of R$ 0.32 per liter, resulting in a total of R$ 1.12 per liter for national producers. The monthly cost is R$ 3 billion, totaling R$ 6 billion over two months, with potential extension to R$ 12 billion. The measure aims to counter the impact of the Middle East war on fuel prices and is fully funded by the Union, without state involvement.

item.title: PSDB pula de zero para 6 deputados federais no RJ
item.description: The PSDB in Rio de Janeiro went from zero to six federal deputies after affiliating lawmakers who left União Brasil, Republicanos, and PP. Luciano Vieira, who already led the state party, heads the group including Marcos Soares, Ricardo Abrahão, Juninho do Pneu, Murilo Gouveia, and Marcelo Queiroz. The party aims to expand its bench to eight deputies in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lulômetro: desaprovação do presidente atinge novo pico
item.description: President Lula's government recorded its lowest approval rating since the start of his term, with 48% of the population viewing the administration as bad or terrible, according to the Lulômetro, a daily indicator by Realtime Big Data in partnership with O Antagonista. This marks the highest disapproval level ever recorded in the survey, signaling growing public dissatisfaction.

item.title: Lindbergh pede a Moraes a prisão preventiva de Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) requested preventive detention for Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) from STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes, alleging the latter sought to intimidate TSE ministers by threatening to involve U.S. authorities in sanctions against judges perceived as biased in the 2026 elections. Eduardo Bolsonaro, residing in the U.S. since 2025, is already under STF investigation for procedural coercion; Lindbergh proposed electronic monitoring as an alternative if preventive detention is denied.

item.title: Soraya Thronicke deixa Podemos e se filia ao PSB visando reeleição ao Senado
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (MS) officially joined the PSB one day before the party-switching window closed, aiming for Senate re-election in 2026. Her move, endorsed by Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, aims to form a ticket with federal deputy Vander Loubet (PT) in Mato Grosso do Sul. Thronicke has changed parties four times in under a decade, having been elected under PSL in 2018, later joining União Brasil via its merger with DEM, and previously being affiliated with Podemos.

item.title: Soraya Thronicke deixa o Podemos e se filia ao PSB de olho na reeleição ao Senado
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke left Podemos and joined the PSB with the goal of running for re-election to the Senate in 2026. The move was supported by Vice President Geraldo Alckmin and sets up a potential ticket with federal deputy Vander Loubet (PT) in Mato Grosso do Sul. Thronicke has changed parties four times in under a decade, having been elected under PSL in 2018 and running for president in 2022 under União Brasil.

item.title: Novo pacote do governo contra efeitos da guerra no Oriente Médio pode custar R$ 9,5 bi por dois meses
item.description: The Lula government announced a package of measures to mitigate the effects of the Middle East war, with an initial cost of R$ 9.5 billion over two months, potentially reaching R$ 15 billion. The plan includes diesel subsidies (national and imported), Pis/Cofins exemptions on aviation fuel and biodiesel, LPG subsidies, and higher taxes on cigarettes and petroleum exports. The government expects increased oil revenue (estimated at R$ 40 billion annually) to offset the expenses.

item.title: “Pedra no sapato”: Nikolas cresce e já incomoda o clã Bolsonaro
item.description: The rise of Nikolas Ferreira in the conservative field, driven by his strong presence among youth and on social media, is beginning to challenge the Bolsonaro clan’s dominance, being described as a 'stone in the shoe' of the family. While currently aligned with Flávio Bolsonaro in the short term, his growing autonomy could spark an internal rift on the right in the medium term, particularly due to the fragmentation of Bolsonarism.

item.title: Lula quer criminalizar aumento abusivo de preços
item.description: The Lula government plans to send to Congress a bill that criminalizes unjustified and abusive price increases, as well as deliberate supply restrictions, classifying them as 'crimes against the popular economy'. The initiative, under urgency regime, involves the ministries of Finance, Planning, Mines and Energy, and Ports and Airports, initially targeting fuel stations and other strategic sectors.

item.title: Lindbergh pede ao STF prisão preventiva de Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a request for preventive detention with the STF against Eduardo Bolsonaro, alleging he is organizing an international pressure network abroad to influence U.S. authorities to target TSE ministers during the October elections. The petition claims this undermines national sovereignty and democratic institutions, and requests precautionary measures and referral to the PGR and PF for investigation.

item.title: Insistência em Código de Ética reabre disputas e fragiliza Fachin entre os pares
item.description: The insistence of STF President Edson Fachin on advancing a Code of Ethics is causing friction among justices, who view the initiative as damaging to the Court’s image amid ongoing credibility crises. Although he has quiet support from Ministers Cármen Lúcia and André Mendonça, Fachin faces growing discontent from the majority, which fears the debate could become politicized in an election year. The situation is exacerbated by controversies involving Justices Alexandre de Moraes and Dias Toffoli in the Master Case, deepening perceptions of conflicts of interest within the Court.

item.title: Presidente do PT pede que eleitores atuem como porta-vozes de Lula
item.description: Edinho Silva, national president of the Workers' Party (PT), urged Lula's supporters to act as spokespersons for the federal government, spreading information and countering disinformation. He praised the Lula administration as the most successful since Brazil's redemocratization, citing infrastructure, social programs, tax reform, and anti-corruption efforts. He also called for mass mobilizations on May 1, 2026, against the 6×1 work schedule, framing it as a struggle for truth and justice.

item.title: “O desgaste do larápio continua”, diz Nikolas
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) celebrated on his Instagram story President Lula's lowest approval rating in the Lulômeter, stating that 'the wear and tear of the rascal continues'. He said the opposition is pursuing youth support, as promised, and reinforced public fatigue with the PT. The post was originally published on O Antagonista.

item.title: Governo propõe pena de até cinco anos para aumentos abusivos de preço
item.description: The Lula government will send to Congress, under urgency regime, a bill that toughens penalties for abusive fuel price increases, classifying them as crimes against the popular economy with imprisonment ranging from two to five years. Additionally, a provisional measure will be issued to strengthen the ANP’s authority, allowing it to shut down gas stations and commercial establishments engaging in artificial price inflation or stock restriction, expanding its power beyond fines to include sanctions against both individuals and corporations.

item.title: Rede aciona o STF para aplicar lei de cotas em concurso da PF
item.description: The Rede Sustentabilidade party filed an action with the Supreme Federal Court to apply the new quota law (30% for Black, brown, and quilombola candidates) to an ongoing Federal Police contest, challenging the article that excludes contests with edicts opened before the law’s sanction. The party argues the norm should be interpreted to expand, not reduce, constitutional protection for beneficiary groups, and requested that Minister Flávio Dino serve as rapporteur of the case.

item.title: Bolsonaro processa André Janones por calúnia e difamação
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro filed a criminal complaint for defamation against federal deputy André Janones over claims that Bolsonaro 'ordered the killing of Lula and Alckmin' and was coordinating with Donald Trump. The complaint, filed at the STF on March 30, argues the statements were personally offensive, lacked political critique, and aimed to incite hatred. Bolsonaro also claims he was denied the right to respond due to house arrest restrictions.

item.title: TSE e Google fazem ação digital sobre prazo para regularizar o título de eleitor
item.description: The TSE and Google launched a joint initiative to improve access to the Electoral Self-Service portal, featuring a direct link on Google Brazil's homepage. The campaign encourages voter registration updates by May 6, the final day to begin online first-time voter registration, ahead of the electoral roll closure for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: O patrimônio de Moraes | Lula come paca
item.description: On the Papo Antagonista show, discussions focused on the alleged tripling of Minister Alexandre de Moraes' wealth since joining the Supreme Court, and President Lula's unconventional Easter lunch featuring paca meat. The segment raises scrutiny over public officials' financial growth and the president's dietary choices.

item.title: Quase metade dos advogados entrevistados pela OAB-SP avalia atuação do STF como ‘muito negativa’
item.description: Nearly half (47.69%) of lawyers surveyed by OAB-SP rated the STF's performance as 'very negative', while only 3.65% rated it 'very positive'. A majority (64.10%) support fixed eight-year terms for justices, and 81.89% believe the selection process for justices needs reform. The survey, conducted between December 2025 and March 2026 with 12,700 lawyers, reflects a deepening crisis of trust in the STF amid allegations linking justices to the Banco Master financial fraud investigation.

item.title: Flávio participa de culto da Assembleia de Deus em São Paulo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) attended a service of the Assembleia de Deus Ministério do Belém in São Paulo on Monday morning, the 6th. During the event, Bishop José Wellington Bezerra da Costa prayed for him, saying: "May the Lord lead you to become president of our nation". Flávio went up to the pulpit, knelt down, and received the prayer in front of the attending workers.

item.title: Governo ampliará poder da ANP para punir empresa que não reduzir diesel
item.description: The Lula government announced it will expand ANP’s authority to penalize business owners who fail to pass on diesel price reductions, including sanctions against their CPF, not just CNPJ. The policy includes a R$1.20 per liter diesel subsidy, equally funded by the federal government and states, totaling R$4 billion over two months, extendable. Penalties will be included in an urgency bill, with new criminal classifications for those who 'undermine' the popular economy.

item.title: Rara e cara: por que carne de paca feita por Janja para Lula tem alto custo
item.description: First Lady Janja prepared paca meat for President Lula's Easter lunch, sparking social media attention. The dish is considered rare and expensive in Brazil due to the species' low reproductive rate and strict legal restrictions, allowing consumption only from IBAMA-authorized breeding farms. Lula praised the meal as 'divine,' emphasizing its exclusivity and taste.

item.title: Brasil assume presidência da Zona de Paz e Cooperação do Atlântico Sul
item.description: Brazil will assume the presidency of the Zone of Peace and Cooperation in the South Atlantic (Zopacas) following the 9th Ministerial Meeting in Rio de Janeiro, succeeding Cape Verde for two or three years. The meeting, expected to include President Lula’s participation, aims to sign three documents: a marine environment convention, a cooperation strategy with 14 thematic areas, and the Rio de Janeiro Declaration, reinforcing regional commitment to denuclearization and cooperation without referencing external conflicts such as those in the Middle East or Eastern Europe.

item.title: Governo Lula amplia subsídio ao diesel com novo pacote de R$ 9 bi
item.description: The Lula government launched a R$ 9 billion diesel subsidy package, offering up to R$ 1.20 per liter for imported diesel and R$ 0.80 for domestically produced diesel, adding to an existing R$ 0.32 subsidy. Half the cost is covered by the federal government and half by participating states, with 25 federative units already signaling support. The measure aims to counter fuel price spikes driven by the Middle East war and may be extended for two more months.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo sai em defesa de Neymar contra ‘lacradores’
item.description: Former minister Aldo Rebelo, a pre-candidate for president, defended Neymar against recent criticism, calling it 'unacceptable absurdity'. In a social media video, he cited Romário and Ronaldo to emphasize Neymar's importance to the national team and called for respect toward the player's football legacy.

item.title: Confúcio Moura defende formação de blocos partidários, pela governabilidade
item.description: Senator Confúcio Moura (MDB-RO) criticized Brazil's fragmented party system, pointing out difficulties in forming electoral slates due to a lack of candidates with significant electoral expression and the current public campaign financing model. He advocated for reducing the number of parties and forming two major partisan blocs to improve governability and ease negotiations in Congress.

item.title: Lula aumenta pacote de bondades sobre combustíveis
item.description: The federal government announced a new round of fuel subsidies, zeroing PIS/Cofins taxes on aviation kerosene and biodiesel, expanding benefits already in place since March. The measures focus on diesel and LPG, aiming to reduce the cost of living and support productive sectors.

item.title: Irmão de Michelle Bolsonaro confirma pré-candidatura a deputado distrital pelo DF
item.description: Carlos Eduardo Antunes Torres, foster brother of Michelle Bolsonaro, confirmed his pre-candidacy for district deputy in the Federal District in the 2026 elections under the PL party. He stated that Jair Bolsonaro's health remains the priority and said he would campaign if authorized to visit him, adding he would support Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in a presidential run if called upon. Bolsonaro's defense requested Torres be authorized to visit the ex-president's residence without prior court approval, but the STF required proof of professional qualifications to act as a caregiver.

item.title: O pacote do governo Lula para tentar frear alta do diesel e das passagens aéreas
item.description: The Lula government announced a package of measures to curb rising diesel and airfare prices in response to the impacts of the war between the U.S., Israel, and Iran. The package includes a provisional measure tightening penalties for abusive price hikes, a bill proposing up to five years in prison for such practices, subsidies for diesel import and production, federal tax exemptions on biodiesel, and LPG import subsidies, with total costs in the billions of reais and adherence from 25 federal units.

item.title: Crusoé: Deixem a IA ajudar o eleitor
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has banned providers from using AI systems to rank, recommend, or suggest political content, a move the article argues harms voters by restricting access to personalized information during the 2026 elections. The policy is criticized as pessimistic and counterproductive, as it prevents AI from helping citizens make more informed voting decisions.

item.title: Novo pacote do governo contra alta dos combustíveis tem isenção de imposto, subvenção extra de diesel e linhas de crédito; veja medidas
item.description: The Lula government unveiled a package to mitigate fuel price impacts, featuring a R$1.20/liter subsidy for imported diesel (with states contributing R$0.60/liter) and R$0.80/liter for domestically produced diesel, adding to the existing R$0.32/liter subsidy. It also includes PIS/Cofins tax exemption, stricter penalties for price gouging (up to 5 years in prison), and cheaper credit lines for airlines. Measures will be enacted via MP, bill, and presidential decrees, effective April–May 2026, with a total cost of R$4 billion.
